## CELLULITIS & ERYSIPELAS
Skin and soft tissue infections without abscess or other sign of purulence.
MRSA coverage is typically unnecessary when there is no purulence, even in
patients with a history of MRSA colonization or infection. It may be considered
for specific patients with the considerations listed below but is not
recommended as the default choice.
Elevation, good skin hygiene, and support stockings are recommended.
## Inpatient

## Duration: Treat for 5 - 7 days
## Cellulitis without systemic signs of infection, oral transition
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R]
## Alternative for Penicillin Allergy or with MRSA considerations*
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h [R,DI]
< OR >
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h [DI]
## Cellulitis with systemic signs of infection
Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R]
< OR >
Nafcillin 2 gm IV q4h [DI]
## Alternative for penicillin allergy or with MRSA considerations*
*Penetrating trauma (including injection drug use), a history of MRSA infection,
or infections not responding to first line beta-lactams
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R]
< OR >
Linezolid 600 mg PO q12h [DI,O]
## Cellulitis in patients with signs of complicated or deeper infections
(e.g. bullae, skin sloughing, hypotension, evidence of organ dysfunction, severe
immunosuppression).
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h [R]
## Alternative for penicillin allergy:
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] <AND>
metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI,H]

## Outpatient

## Duration: 5 days
## Empirical outpatient treatment for cellulitis
Beta-lactam reaction assessment
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO bid for 5 days ($) [R]
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID for 5 days ($) [R]
Non-VA order for above
## Alternative for penicillin allergy or with MRSA considerations
Consider MRSA coverage for cellulitis associated with penetrating trauma
(including injection drug use), neutropenia, or infections not improving on
first line beta-lactams, history of MRSA skin infection.
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID for 5 days ($) [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Linezolid 600 mg PO BID for 5 days ($) [DI,O]
